criteria.requirement: Extend actual TemplateStream.dump to recognize str/bytes/os.PathLike via os.fspath before opening owned binary files, keeping default UTF-8 and explicit encoding/errors. Never coerce arbitrary objects with str. Preserve buffered/unbuffered streamed output, existing file-like writelines/write behavior and caller-owned stream lifetime; owned files close on write/encode failure. Reject bad __fspath__ return types through standard semantics and prove Unicode byte parity with string paths.
